items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: I think Steve Luce made a recorded record of that... Steve Luce recorded a record of that. Used to play out here on Charler Street.

ctx.x: Now you mentioned that all together. What is that like?

I think Steve Luce made a recorded record of that, That Oughta Get It. That's where they go. Did it have words on there? Yeah it had words too. I just can't remember. Steve Luce recorded a record of that. Used to play out here on Charler Street.
